#Module history

Window, Location and History (HTML). Navigations requested by a module happen from a task of their own, never inside the call; same-document changes (pushState, fragments) fire popstate / hashchange as HTML says.

Exposed to: Window. Source: api/history.widl.

#Types

#handle Window : Object

The Window object (an EventTarget: popstate, hashchange, storage...).

#enum ScrollRestoration : i32

What history.scrollRestoration says: whether the browser restores the scroll positions of an entry shown again.

membervalue
Auto0
Manual1

#History_pushState

void History_pushState(optional string state, optional string url) raises

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: History_pushState :: proc(c: ^Call, state: Maybe(string), url: Maybe(string)) -> Api_Error

#History_go

void History_go(i32 delta = 0)

history.go(delta): back() is go(-1), forward() go(1), go(0) reloads. Asynchronous.

#History_set_scrollRestoration

void History_set_scrollRestoration(ScrollRestoration mode)
